hooks.command: node -e "const d=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync(0,'utf8'));process.stdout.write(d.tool_response&&d.tool_response.filePath||d.tool_input.file_path)" | { read -r f; if [ -f "$f" ]; then npx prettier --write "$f" --ignore-unknown; case "$f" in *.js|*.jsx|*.ts|*.tsx|*.mjs|*.cjs) npx eslint --fix "$f";; esac; fi; } 2>/dev/null || true
